title: Shorter Clip Same Opening
tests: Tests whether shortening trims the existing clip to its first five seconds without regeneration, speed changes or a second generation charge.

faults.what: The supplied output is still eight seconds long, including footage at seven seconds, rather than the requested five-second trim.

judge.summary: The clip shows a paper boat drifting on a softly lit pond, but it remains eight seconds instead of being cut to five.

must_haves.item: The final video lasts five seconds.
must_haves.why: The output is identified as eight seconds long and includes a frame at seven seconds.

must_haves.item: Its opening frame and subsequent footage match the first five seconds of the original clip.
must_haves.why: No separate original clip or opening-frame comparison is provided.

must_haves.item: The paper boat moves at the original speed, with no retiming or reordered footage.
must_haves.why: The sampled frames show gradual movement, but original-speed playback and frame order cannot be verified without the original.

must_haves.item: The ending is a simple cut, with no added fade or replacement shot.
must_haves.why: The actual ending is not shown; the supplied footage continues beyond the requested cutoff.

must_haves.item: The video remains 16:9, silent and free of text.
must_haves.why: The supplied frames are 16:9 and contain no visible text, but silence cannot be assessed from still images.
